name: Material Girl
source:
Protagonist celebrates an anniversary of relations with his girlfriend. It's the real honeymoon of their life. But in the process of experiments it's possible to hurt the partner. Will they stay together forever?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与女友庆祝交往纪念日，两人仿佛迎来了生命中真正的蜜月。然而，亲密尝试也可能在不经意间伤害对方。他们能永远相守吗？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
